laws.rule: Rila National Park: stay on marked routes; camping and fires only at marked sites; no vehicles off designated roads without the directorate's permission; no bathing or swimming in rivers and lakes; no flower picking or collecting rocks, fossils or minerals; dogs on a lead; fishing only at marked sites. Breaches are fined 500 to 5,000 leva for individuals (as published by the ministry; not converted).
